description: This Java class implements an immutable version of the CreateThingLiveCommand, handling creation of 'things' in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of CreateThingLiveCommand, encapsulating a 'Thing' and providing methods to access its details and generate responses.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of CreateThingLiveCommand from a general Command object, casting it to a CreateThing command.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID of the Thing associated with this command, or null if not present.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the Thing object associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new command instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command modifies authorization; always returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for creating a response to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this instance, including its class name and superclass details.
